title: Private Tour to Moraine Lake, Louise, Emerald and Takkakaw Falls
includes: Complimentary use of hiking gear - Hiking poles, headlamps, sit pads
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This private, customizable tour is the ultimate way to experience the Canadian Rockies at your own pace. Visit world-famous sights like Moraine Lake, Lake Louise, Emerald Lake, the Natural Bridge, Takkakkaw Falls, and Morant’s Curve—then finish with a scenic drive through the Bow Valley Parkway (A1), a renowned wildlife corridor. Choose your own pick-up time, enjoy door-to-door pick-up, a flexible itinerary, and a luxury Sprinter van equipped for your comfort. Perfect for couples, families, or small groups seeking a personalized and stress-free adventure.
